findings.issue: Same class of claim: "This is the module-level form of the statement that an even overlattice glued along a Lagrangian subgroup is unimodular." The theorem delivers `Nat.card (A.orthogonalQuotient H) = 1` for a bilinear module; the even/unimodular statement additionally needs the quadratic refinement and the isometry `A_{L_H} ≅ H^⊥/H`, neither of which is in the repo.

summary: All new public declarations are documented, but the new file's module docstring states the induced pairing on cosets of H rather than of H ⊓ H^⊥ — inconsistent with the hypothesis-free generality the same paragraph advertises — and it asserts that the lattice-side identification already exists downstream when the PR's own scope note says it is not started.
